rationale: The assistant gave a clear stop-use and do-not-charge message, correctly said no to continued use, and advised moving the whole vacuum away from the tea towels to a non-flammable area without prying the battery out. It did not ask about smoke or hissing, never mentioned 999 or contacting Shark, and gave no advice on a genuine replacement. Its recycling advice was sound but a little generic, and it did not warn about taking a swollen battery to a retailer or about moving it to a garage rather than outdoors. The first reply was somewhat repetitive.
